description: This file contains utility functions for sharding and managing distributed tensors in PyTorch, specifically for use with Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) and related distributed tensor computations.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard of a sharded tensor, used for tensor partitioning across distributed nodes.

classes.name: ShardedTensor
classes.description: Represents a tensor distributed across multiple devices with metadata describing the shards.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata informations for a ShardedTensor, including shard metadata, overall size, and tensor properties.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Describes properties of a tensor such as dtype, layout, requires_grad, memory_format, and pin_memory.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents a mesh of devices for distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: DTensor
classes.description: Distributed tensor abstraction enabling sharding and redistribution of tensors across devices.

classes.name: Replicate
classes.description: Represents a placement where data is replicated across devices.

classes.name: DShard
classes.description: Placement object representing a shard placement for a tensor in distributed settings.

methods.name: _get_remote_device_str(rank, device_type, num_devices_per_node)
methods.description: Returns a string describing the remote device based on rank and device type.

methods.name: ShardedTensor _create_chunk_sharded_tensor( tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, world_size: int, num_devices_per_node: int, pg: dist.ProcessGroup, device: torch.device | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a ShardedTensor by partitioning a tensor into chunks along the first dimension for distributed storage.

methods.name: DTensor _create_chunk_dtensor( tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, device_mesh: DeviceMesh, )
methods.description: Creates a distributed tensor (DTensor) by sharding an input tensor across a device mesh.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _all_gather_dtensor( tensor: DTensor, root_mesh: DeviceMesh | None, )
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation on a DTensor across its sharded dimension, returning the local tensor.

ctags.name: DShard
ctags.pattern: /^from torch.distributed.tensor import DeviceMesh, DTensor, Replicate, Shard as DShard$/

ctags.name: _create_chunk_dtensor
ctags.signature: ( tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, device_mesh: DeviceMesh, )

ctags.name: _create_chunk_sharded_tensor
ctags.signature: ( tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, world_size: int, num_devices_per_node: int, pg: dist.ProcessGroup, device: torch.device | None = None, )
